data.title: Can Cardano Reach $1 Before Bitcoin Reaches $100,000?
data.description: Cardano needs a fourfold surge while Bitcoin chases a relatively modest gain, but the race to these milestone prices is far less straightforward than the numbers suggest. One coin carries a hidden weight that could derail its climb before it even gets started.
